_comment: Batch 014 -- a light fixture family per theme.
L_light_family_silhouette.png is the sheet this batch lives or dies by.
The brief was explicit that identity must come from form, mounting,
materials and construction rather than bulb hue, so the test is whether
twelve fixtures are still twelve objects with the colour taken away.

shots.name: L_light_family
shots.caption: TWELVE FIXTURES, SIX THEMES - HUNG ABOVE, WALL-MOUNTED BELOW
shots.note: CONCRETE'S TWO ARE BATCH 001/002 AND ARE THE CONTROL

shots.name: L_pair_concrete
shots.caption: CONCRETE FACILITY - THE APPROVED CONTROL, NOT REBUILT
shots.note: ITS FAMILY ALREADY EXISTED. A THIRD WOULD BE PADDING

shots.name: L_pair_rusted
shots.caption: RUSTED INDUSTRIAL - CAGED BULKHEAD, CLAMP-ON WORK LIGHT

shots.name: L_pair_neon
shots.caption: NEON TRANSIT - RECESSED CHANNEL, PLATFORM-EDGE STRIP
shots.note: INFRASTRUCTURE, NOT SIGNAGE. THE EDGE STRIP LIGHTS THE FLOOR

shots.name: L_pair_gothic
shots.caption: GOTHIC STONE - IRON CORONA, GLAZED LANTERN
shots.note: NATIVE IRON. THE LANTERN HAS A ROOF BECAUSE A FLAME NEEDS ONE

shots.name: L_pair_temple
shots.caption: TEMPLE RUIN - SUSPENDED BRASS BOWL, CARVED NICHE
shots.note: THE BOSS IS THE BUILDING; THE BOWL IS WHAT WAS HUNG FROM IT

shots.name: L_pair_void
shots.caption: VOID GLITCH - THE MOUNT WITH NO FIXTURE, AND A PLACEHOLDER
shots.note: STILL A LIGHT SOURCE. THAT WAS THE ONE HARD REQUIREMENT
